items.title_zh: Moderna与默沙东宣布mRNA癌症疫苗三期成功，黑色素瘤复发风险显著降低
items.title_en: Moderna and Merck Report Phase 3 Success for Personalized mRNA Cancer Vaccine in Melanoma
items.summary: Moderna and Merck announced that their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine plus Keytruda met primary and key secondary endpoints in a phase 3 melanoma trial, significantly reducing recurrence and metastasis risk.

items.summary: OpenRouter is joining Stripe after Stripe's reported $7B acquisition, marking a major consolidation in the AI infrastructure space.

items.title: 长征十号乙完成一子级海上回收，为全球首次网系回收  7 月 10 日，长征十号乙运载火箭从海南商业航天发射场升空。
items.title_zh: 长征十号乙完成全球首次海上网系回收
items.title_en: Long March 10B Achieves World-First Sea-Based Net Rocket Recovery
items.summary: Long March 10B completed the world's first sea-based net recovery of a rocket first stage, marking China's first controlled recovery of a launch vehicle first stage.

items.summary: A humorous domain registration spirals into a serious conflict involving weather balloon tracking and geopolitical tensions.

items.title_en: GrapheneOS says Motorola devices may get official support by 2027
items.summary: GrapheneOS announces that select Motorola devices (2027 Signature, Razr fold/flip) may receive official support by 2027, with Motorola currently porting GrapheneOS to their hardware.

items.summary: Cerebras announces its next-generation CS-4 chip, claiming doubled performance with doubled power.

items.title: How much of the weight-space perception gap is actually symmetry? Evidence from ~1.8M fitted SIRENs [R]
items.title_zh: 仅对称性即可重现权重空间感知差距的大部分
items.title_en: Symmetry Alone Can Reproduce Most of the Weight-Space Perception Gap
items.summary: An empirical study using ~1.8M fitted SIRENs to disentangle how parameter symmetries contribute to the weight-space perception gap between shared-init and independently trained networks.

items.title: 🤖 Anthropic 呼吁全球放缓前沿 AI 开发  Anthropic 呼吁全球主要 AI 实验室考虑放缓前沿模型开发节奏。
items.title_zh: Anthropic 呼吁全球协调放缓前沿 AI 开发
items.title_en: Anthropic Urges Global Coordination to Slow Frontier AI Development
items.summary: Anthropic calls for international coordination to pause frontier AI development due to risks of recursive self-improvement, a proposal that faces criticism from Washington, Silicon Valley, and concerns about China's strategic advantage.

items.title: ♻️ 美国放行 H200 对华销售，英伟达寻求在华突破  路透社报道，美国商务部已批准约 10 家中国企业购买英伟达 H200 芯片，相关买家包括阿里巴巴、腾讯
items.title_zh: 美批准H200对华销售，阿里腾讯等约10家中企获准
items.title_en: US Approves Nvidia H200 Sales to About 10 Chinese Firms
items.summary: US Commerce Department approved sales of Nvidia H200 chips to about 10 Chinese companies including Alibaba and Tencent, but no deliveries have been completed yet as firms remain cautious under Beijing's guidance.
